tail:
Batch 14’s A/B authoring is complete. The B page now includes both a singular repulsive power tail and a hard-core potential with a stable attractive algebraic tail.

The draft items are [the model definition](/Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/items/def-tdmath-stable-power-tempered-particle-model.md), [integral bridge](/Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/items/lem-tdmath-measure-integral-agrees-with-root-lebesgue-integral.md), [cutoff lemma](/Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/items/lem-tdmath-particle-exponential-cutoff.md), [cube-tail lemma](/Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/items/lem-tdmath-separated-cube-tail-bound.md), [pressure theorem](/Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/items/thm-tdmath-stable-tempered-free-cube-grand-pressure.md), and [the two examples](/Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/items/ex-tdmath-repulsive-power-tail.md) and [attractive-tail example](/Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/items/ex-tdmath-hard-core-attractive-power-tail.md).

The [A page](/Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/library/thermodynamics-mathematics/td-math-continuum-pressure.md), [B page](/Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/library/thermodynamics-mathematics/td-math-continuum-pressure-examples.md), [manifest](/Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-td-qft-rpm-62-2026-10-14-batch-14.pages.json), [proof contracts](/Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-td-qft-rpm-62-2026-10-14-batch-14.proof-contracts.json), [source coverage](/Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-td-qft-rpm-62-2026-10-14-batch-14.coverage.json), [cross-batch evidence](/Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-td-qft-rpm-62-2026-10-14-batch-14.cross-batch-dependencies.json), and [batch notes](/Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-td-qft-rpm-62-2026-10-14-batch-14.notes.md) are updated.

**Checks:** precheck passed 6/6 proof-bearing items; rendercheck passed 9 files; focused dependency checks passed; strict contracts passed 6/6; coverage recorded 13 results with no warnings; source-fetch-check verified 6/6 sources; and the scoped 32-item level recomputation had no mismatches. Full-text sources are recorded in coverage, including [Adams’s lecture notes](https://files-www.mis.mpg.de/mpi-typo3/preprints/ln/lecturenote-3006.pdf), [Fisher–Lebowitz](https://cmsr.rutgers.edu/images/people/lebowitz_joel/publications-archived/jll.pub_69.pdf), [Ruelle](https://www.e-periodica.ch/cntmng?pid=hpa-001%3A1963%3A36%3A%3A1128&bot=1), [Tao’s notes](https://terrytao.wordpress.com/2010/09/25/245a-notes-3-integration-on-abstract-measure-spaces-and-the-convergence-theorems/), [Hunter’s notes](https://www.math.ucdavis.edu/~hunter/measure_theory/measure_notes_ch4.pdf), and [MIT’s full lecture notes](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/18-102-introduction-to-functional-analysis-spring-2021/8fb8d5c170f1613151aca71de21027bc_MIT18_102s21_full_lec.pdf).

Two readiness-record details are noted in the batch notes: the model-definition record has an empty explicit dependency list although its six direct prerequisites are in the manifest, and the attractive-tail example’s escalation hash predates its final proof clarification. Both remain escalated and were not overwritten.
